name: color_atlas
description: Browser-native color toolkit: palette extraction from images, color harmony, WCAG contrast checker, color blindness simulator, gradient generator. All WASM-powered, zero server uploads.

tools.name: color_atlas_convert
tools.description: Convert a color between formats: hex, rgb, hsl, hsv, lab, css. Returns all format representations for the given color.

color.description: Color in hex format, e.g. '#3B82F6' or '#f00' or 'ff8800'.

format.description: Optional single format to return. If omitted, all formats are returned.

tools.name: color_atlas_contrast
tools.description: Check WCAG 2.1 contrast compliance between foreground and background colors. Returns ratio and AA/AAA pass/fail for normal and large text.

tools.name: color_atlas_harmony
tools.description: Generate color harmony variations from a base color: complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic, monochromatic, shades, or tints.

count.description: Number of colors to generate for monochromatic/shades/tints variants.

tools.name: color_atlas_cvd
tools.description: Simulate how a color appears to people with color vision deficiency: protanopia (red-blind), deuteranopia (green-blind), and tritanopia (blue-blind).
